g.text: DIR. S. BELMIROHA · SCENE 07: THE INTERVIEW · DIALOGUE
DET: "Third body this month. Same knot."
SUSPECT: "I don't know what you're talking about."
SUSPECT: (reaches for photo, doesn't touch it)
SUSPECT: "It wasn't supposed to be three."
